The '''Skärtis system''' was a star system located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]] and contained the planet [[Skärtis]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Skärtis system was first introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'',<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> where technical limitations prevented it from including the umlaut.<ref name="Fry">{{EmailCite|email=File:AtlasEmail-2025-09-03.png|creator=[[Jason Fry]]|date=2025-09-03}}</ref>
